test_detect_file_drop: test the _detect_file_drop function to detect dragged or pasted file paths from slash commands
test_image_file_detection: test _detect_file_drop correctly identifies image files by extension like png, jpg, gif, webp, and svg
test_non_image_file_detection: test _detect_file_drop correctly identifies non-image files like python scripts and makefiles
test_escaped_spaces_handling: test _detect_file_drop handles macOS escaped spaces in file paths like my\ file.png
test_non_file_input_rejection: test _detect_file_drop returns None for slash commands, empty strings, nonexistent paths, and directories
